label: Bible Study
prompt: Out of the same _____ proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verse: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
note: Blessing and cursing from the same mouth — James says it shouldn't be so.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Till he fill thy mouth with _____, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verse: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
note: Bildad got this one right: God will yet fill thy mouth with laughing — and by the last chapter, Job is restored double.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there _____ the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verse: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
note: Babel's builders wanted to make a name; they got one — the place where the language got confounded.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not _____: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verse: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
note: The Day of Atonement scapegoat carried Israel's sins off into the wilderness, never to wander back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But Mary kept all these things, and _____ them in her heart.
verse: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
note: After the shepherds' visit, Mary kept it all and 'pondered' — turned it over and over — in her heart.
